THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS count, COUNT(*) AS entire_count FROM om_cloud_optimizer_tbl ocot WHERE 1 = 1 AND resource_org_size >= 0 AND resource_type > 0

WITH RECURSIVE recursive_cte AS ( SELECT resource_no, resource_parent_no, resource_no AS top_parent, resource_name, 1 AS level, resource_type, resource_new_size_type1, resource_new_size_type2, resource_org FROM om_cloud_optimizer_tbl WHERE resource_no = #{resource_no} UNION ALL SELECT c.resource_no, c.resource_parent_no, p.top_parent, c.resource_name, p.level + 1, c.resource_type, c.resource_new_size_type1, c.resource_new_size_type2, c.resource_org FROM om_cloud_optimizer_tbl c JOIN recursive_cte p ON c.resource_parent_no = p.resource_no ), subquery_log_count AS ( SELECT ocrlt.resource_no, sum(cnt) AS call_cnt FROM public.om_resource_call_cnt_month ocrlt GROUP BY ocrlt.resource_no ) SELECT r.resource_name, LPAD('', r.level - 1, '--') || r.resource_name AS indented_resource_name, r.resource_no, r.resource_parent_no, r.top_parent AS top_parent_resource_no, r.level, r.resource_type, r.resource_new_size_type1, r.resource_new_size_type2, r.resource_org, COALESCE(s.call_cnt, 0) AS call_cnt FROM recursive_cte r LEFT JOIN subquery_log_count s ON r.resource_no = s.resource_no ORDER BY top_parent, resource_no;
SELECT * FROM om_cloud_optimizer_tbl ocot WHERE resource_org like CONCAT('%',#{resource_org},'')

SELECT * FROM om_cloud_optimizer_rel_tbl ocort LEFT JOIN om_cloud_optimizer_tbl ocot ON ocort.resource_no = ocot.resource_no WHERE page_no = #{page_no} and resource_type > 0 ORDER BY resource_type, resource_name

SELECT resource_status, count(*) FROM om_cloud_optimizer_tbl ocot WHERE resource_type = #{resource_type} AND resource_org_size > 0
GROUP BY resource_status UNION ALL SELECT 99, COUNT(*) FROM om_cloud_optimizer_tbl WHERE resource_type = #{resource_type} AND resource_org_size >= 0
UNION ALL SELECT -99, COUNT(*) FROM om_cloud_optimizer_tbl WHERE resource_type = #{resource_type} AND resource_org_size < 0

WITH RECURSIVE ResourceHierarchy AS ( SELECT resource_no, resource_name, resource_parent_no, site_no, 0 AS level FROM om_cloud_optimizer_tbl WHERE resource_parent_no = 0 UNION ALL SELECT child.resource_no, child.resource_name, child.resource_parent_no, child.site_no, parent.level + 1 AS level FROM om_cloud_optimizer_tbl AS child INNER JOIN ResourceHierarchy AS parent ON child.resource_parent_no = parent.resource_no WHERE child.resource_type = 0 ) SELECT LPAD('', level, ' ') || resource_no AS indented_resource_no, resource_no, resource_name, resource_parent_no, site_no, level, 0 AS count, 0 AS total_count, 0 AS entire_count FROM ResourceHierarchy ORDER BY level, resource_no;
SELECT SUM(resource_org_size) AS org_sum, SUM(resource_new_size_type2) AS type2_sum FROM om_cloud_optimizer_tbl ocot WHERE resource_new_size_type2 > 0

WITH monthly_calls AS ( ocrlt.resource_no, sum(cnt) AS call_count FROM public.om_resource_call_cnt_month ocrlt WHERE TO_TIMESTAMP(ocrlt.rgstr_date::text, 'YYYYMMDD') >= DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CURRENT_DATE) AND TO_TIMESTAMP(ocrlt.rgstr_date::text, 'YYYYMMDD') < DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CURRENT_DATE) + INTERVAL '1 MONTH' GROUP BY ocrlt.resource_no ) SELECT ocot.resource_type, SUM(mc.month_call_cnt * ocot.resource_org_size) AS org_traffic, SUM(mc.month_call_cnt * ocot.resource_new_size_type2) AS type2_traffic FROM om_cloud_optimizer_tbl ocot LEFT JOIN monthly_calls mc ON mc.resource_no = ocot.resource_no WHERE ocot.resource_type IN (1, 2, 3, 4)
GROUP BY ocot.resource_type;

SELECT ocot.resource_no, ocot.resource_name, ocot.resource_org_size, ocot.resource_new_size_type2, month_call_cnt, month_call_cnt * ocot.resource_org_size as month_org_traffic, month_call_cnt * ocot.resource_new_size_type2 as month_type2_traffic FROM om_cloud_optimizer_tbl ocot LEFT JOIN ( SELECT resource_no, sum(cnt) AS month_call_cnt FROM public.om_resource_call_cnt_month ocrlt WHERE TO_TIMESTAMP(ocrlt.rgstr_date::text, 'YYYYMMDD') >= DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CURRENT_DATE) AND TO_TIMESTAMP(ocrlt.rgstr_date::text, 'YYYYMMDD') < DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CURRENT_DATE) + INTERVAL '1 MONTH' GROUP BY ocrlt.resource_no ) AS sub ON sub.resource_no = ocot.resource_no WHERE ocot.resource_type = ${resource_type}
ORDER BY month_type2_traffic desc LIMIT 10
select resource_type, count(*) from om_cloud_optimizer_tbl ocot group by resource_type

WITH call_count_query AS ( SELECT ocrlt.resource_no, sum(cnt) AS call_count FROM public.om_resource_call_cnt_month ocrlt GROUP BY ocrlt.resource_no ) SELECT ocot.resource_type, SUM(ocot.resource_new_size_type1 * cc.call_count) AS traffic1, SUM(CASE WHEN ocot.resource_new_size_type2 = 0 THEN ocot.resource_new_size_type1 * cc.call_count ELSE ocot.resource_new_size_type2 * cc.call_count END) AS traffic2 FROM om_cloud_optimizer_tbl ocot JOIN call_count_query cc ON ocot.resource_no = cc.resource_no WHERE ocot.resource_new_size_type1 > 0
GROUP BY ocot.resource_type;

WITH call_count_query AS ( SELECT ocrlt.resource_no, sum(cnt) AS call_count FROM public.om_resource_call_cnt_month ocrlt WHERE ocrlt.rgstr_date >= #{startDate} AND ocrlt.rgstr_date < #{endDate} GROUP BY ocrlt.resource_no ) SELECT ocot.resource_status, SUM(ocot.resource_new_size_type1 * cc.call_count) AS traffic1, SUM(CASE WHEN ocot.resource_new_size_type2 = 0 THEN ocot.resource_new_size_type1 * cc.call_count ELSE ocot.resource_new_size_type2 * cc.call_count END) AS traffic2 FROM om_cloud_optimizer_tbl ocot JOIN call_count_query cc ON ocot.resource_no = cc.resource_no WHERE ocot.resource_new_size_type1 > 0
GROUP BY ocot.resource_status;

WITH resource_log_counts AS ( SELECT ocrlt.resource_no, sum(cnt) AS call_count FROM public.om_resource_call_cnt_month ocrlt WHERE ocrlt.rgstr_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY ocrlt.resource_no ) SELECT COALESCE(SUM(rlog.log_count * ocot.resource_new_size_type1), 0) AS traffic1, COALESCE(SUM(rlog.log_count * ocot.resource_new_size_type1 * #{avg_comp_rate}), 0) AS traffic2 FROM om_cloud_optimizer_tbl ocot INNER JOIN resource_log_counts rlog ON ocot.resource_no = rlog.resource_no WHERE ocot.resource_status = 0 AND ocot.resource_org_size > 0

SELECT resource_name, resource_new_size_type1, resource_new_size_type2, (SELECT count(*) FROM om_cloud_resource_log_tbl ocrlt WHERE ocot.resource_no = ocrlt.resource_no) AS 조회수, (SELECT count(*) FROM om_cloud_resource_log_tbl ocrlt WHERE ocot.resource_no = ocrlt.resource_no) * resource_new_size_type1 AS optimizedBeforeTraffic, (SELECT count(*) FROM om_cloud_resource_log_tbl ocrlt WHERE ocot.resource_no = ocrlt.resource_no) * resource_new_size_type2 AS optimizedAfterTraffic FROM om_cloud_optimizer_tbl ocot

WITH statuses AS (SELECT unnest(ARRAY[-1, 0, 1, 2, 11]) AS resource_status), types AS (SELECT unnest(ARRAY[1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9]) AS resource_type), status_type_combinations AS (SELECT s.resource_status, t.resource_type FROM statuses s CROSS JOIN types t) SELECT stc.resource_status, stc.resource_type, COALESCE(COUNT(CASE WHEN 1 = 1 THEN 1 ELSE NULL END), 0) AS status_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM om_cloud_optimizer_tbl ocot2 WHERE 1=1
AND ocot2.resource_type = stc.resource_type) AS type_count, CASE WHEN ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM om_cloud_optimizer_tbl ocot2 WHERE ocot2.resource_org_size > 0 AND ocot2.is_use = 1 AND ocot2.site_no IN (CAST('91' AS INTEGER)) AND ocot2.resource_type = stc.resource_type ) > 0 THEN ( COALESCE( CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN 1 = 1 THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS DECIMAL) / NULLIF( ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM om_cloud_optimizer_tbl ocot2 WHERE 1 = 1 AND ocot2.resource_type = stc.resource_type ), 0 ), 0) * 100 )::int ELSE 0 END AS percentage FROM status_type_combinations stc LEFT JOIN om_cloud_optimizer_tbl ocot1 ON stc.resource_status = ocot1.resource_status AND stc.resource_type = ocot1.resource_type WHERE 1=1 GROUP BY stc.resource_status, stc.resource_type ORDER BY stc.resource_type, stc.resource_status;

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT resource_no, resource_type, resource_name AS x, resource_new_size_type1, resource_status, cloud_no, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ocot.resource_type, ocot.resource_name) AS row_no, (SELECT sum(cnt) FROM public.om_resource_call_cnt_month ocrlt WHERE ocot.resource_no = ocrlt.resource_no) AS call_cnt, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM om_cloud_resource_log_tbl ocrlt WHERE ocot.resource_no = ocrlt.resource_no) * resource_new_size_type1 AS y FROM om_cloud_optimizer_tbl ocot WHERE resource_status = -1 AND resource_type BETWEEN
ORDER BY y DESC LIMIT 10) AS sub_query WHERE sub_query.y > 0

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT resource_no, resource_type, resource_name AS x, resource_new_size_type1, resource_status, 0 AS call_cnt, resource_new_size_type1 AS y FROM om_cloud_optimizer_tbl ocot WHERE resource_status = -1 AND resource_type > 0
ORDER BY y DESC LIMIT 10) AS sub_query WHERE sub_query.y > 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public.om_cloud_resource_log_tbl (rgstr_dt, resource_no, cloud_no, rgstr_date, rgstr_hour, rgstr_min, rgstr_yyyy, rgstr_mm, rgstr_dd, site_no, page_no) VALUES( now(), 18968, 4, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM NOW()) * 10000 + EXTRACT(MONTH FROM NOW()) * 100 + EXTRACT(DAY FROM NOW()), EXTRACT(HOUR FROM CURRENT_TIME), EXTRACT(MINUTE FROM CURRENT_TIME), EXTRACT(YEAR FROM NOW()), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM NOW()), EXTRACT(DAY FROM NOW()), 91, 782 );

SELECT ocrlt.log_sn, ocrlt.rgstr_dt, ocrlt.resource_no, ocot.resource_new_size_type1, ocot.resource_new_size_type2, ocot.resource_type, ocot.resource_status, ocot.org_time, ocot.new_time, 0 AS show_yn FROM om_cloud_resource_log_tbl ocrlt LEFT JOIN om_cloud_optimizer_tbl ocot ON ocrlt.resource_no = ocot.resource_no WHERE ocrlt.rgstr_dt BETWEEN NOW() - INTERVAL '1 second' AND NOW() AND ocot.resource_type > 0
AND ocrlt.site_no IN
CAST(#{item} AS INTEGER)
ORDER BY log_sn

SELECT a.resource_org_size, a.resource_new_size_type2, a.updt_dt, CASE WHEN a.updt_dt IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS resource_status, a.cloud_no, COALESCE(b.resource_call_cnt, 0) AS resource_call_cnt FROM om_cloud_optimizer_tbl a LEFT JOIN ( SELECT resource_no, sum(cnt) AS resource_call_cnt FROM public.om_resource_call_cnt_month ocrlt GROUP BY ocrlt.resource_no ) b ON a.resource_no = b.resource_no WHERE a.resource_type != 0 AND a.resource_org_size != -1;

WITH size_sums AS ( SELECT SUM(resource_new_size_type1) AS type1size_sum, SUM(resource_new_size_type2) AS type2size_sum FROM om_cloud_optimizer_tbl WHERE resource_status = 1
) SELECT type1size_sum, type2size_sum, ROUND((1 - (type2size_sum::numeric / type1size_sum::numeric)) * 100, 1) AS avg_comp_rate FROM size_sums;

SELECT AVG(comp_rate) as avg_comp_rate FROM ( SELECT resource_no, resource_new_size_type1, resource_new_size_type2, resource_new_size_type1 - resource_new_size_type2 as comp_size, CASE WHEN resource_new_size_type2 = 0 THEN 0 ELSE (CAST((resource_new_size_type1 - resource_new_size_type2) AS FLOAT) / resource_new_size_type1)*100 end as comp_rate FROM om_cloud_optimizer_tbl ocot WHERE resource_new_size_type1 > 0
) as sub_query;

SELECT AVG(comp_rate) as avg_comp_rate FROM ( SELECT resource_no, resource_new_size_type1, resource_new_size_type2, resource_new_size_type1 - resource_new_size_type2 as comp_size, CASE WHEN resource_new_size_type2 = 0 THEN 0 ELSE (CAST((resource_new_size_type1 - resource_new_size_type2) AS FLOAT) / resource_new_size_type1)*100 end as comp_rate FROM om_cloud_optimizer_tbl ocot WHERE resource_new_size_type1 > 0 AND resource_new_size_type2 > 0 AND resource_status = 1
) as sub_query;

SELECT resource_status, count(*) FROM om_cloud_optimizer_tbl ocot WHERE rgstr_dt BETWEEN #{startDate_ts} AND #{endDate_ts} AND resource_org_size > -1
GROUP BY resource_status UNION ALL SELECT 99, count(*) FROM om_cloud_optimizer_tbl ocot WHERE rgstr_dt BETWEEN #{startDate_ts} AND #{endDate_ts} AND resource_org_size > -1
UNION ALL SELECT 98, count(*) FROM om_cloud_optimizer_tbl ocot WHERE rgstr_dt BETWEEN #{startDate_ts} AND #{endDate_ts} AND resource_org_size > -1 AND resource_status = -1
SELECT * FROM om_cloud_optimizer_tbl ocot WHERE (resource_status = 0 or resource_status = 11) AND resource_type > 0 AND resource_org_size > 0
mapper.update: UPDATE om_cloud_optimizer_tbl SET resource_status = -1 WHERE (resource_status = 0 OR resource_status = 11)
mapper.select: SELECT SUM(resource_new_size_type1) AS total_unOpt_all_size FROM om_cloud_optimizer_tbl WHERE resource_status != 1 AND resource_type != 0 AND resource_new_size_type1 != -1

SELECT l.resource_no, AVG(call_count) AS avg_call_count_per_day FROM ( SELECT ocrlt.resource_no, sum(cnt) AS call_count FROM public.om_resource_call_cnt_month ocrlt GROUP BY ocrlt.resource_no ) AS l INNER JOIN ( SELECT resource_no, DATE_PART('day', CURRENT_DATE - rgstr_dt) + 1 AS active_days FROM om_cloud_optimizer_tbl GROUP BY resource_no ) AS o ON l.resource_no = o.resource_no GROUP BY l.resource_no;

SELECT resource_parent_no, SUM(CASE WHEN 1 = 1
AND resource_type > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS count, COUNT(*) AS entire_count FROM om_cloud_optimizer_tbl ocot INNER JOIN latest_log ocolt ON ocot.resource_no = ocolt.resource_no AND ocolt.rn = 1 AND ocolt.resource_log_content = '1' WHERE 1 = 1 AND resource_org_size >= 0 AND resource_type > 0
GROUP BY resource_parent_no

SELECT sum(resource_new_size_type1) as type1_size, sum(resource_new_size_type2) as type2_size, ROUND( CAST( ( CAST( ( sum(resource_new_size_type1) - sum(resource_new_size_type2) ) AS FLOAT) / NULLIF(sum(resource_new_size_type1), 0) ) * 100 AS NUMERIC ), 1 ) as percentage FROM om_cloud_optimizer_tbl ocot WHERE 1 = 1 AND resource_new_size_type1 > 0 AND resource_new_size_type2 > 0 AND resource_status = 1

SELECT ROUND(AVG(org_time), 1) AS org_time, ROUND(AVG(new_time), 1) AS new_time, ROUND((SUM(org_time) - SUM(new_time))::NUMERIC / SUM(org_time) * 100, 2) AS percentage FROM om_cloud_optimizer_tbl ocot WHERE org_time > 0 AND new_time > 0 AND resource_type > 0 AND resource_org_size > 0 AND resource_status = 1

SELECT resource_type, ROUND(AVG(org_time), 1) AS org_time, ROUND(AVG(new_time), 1) AS new_time, ROUND((SUM(org_time) - SUM(new_time))::NUMERIC / SUM(org_time) * 100, 2) AS percentage FROM om_cloud_optimizer_tbl ocot WHERE org_time > 0 AND new_time > 0 AND resource_type > 0 AND resource_org_size > 0
GROUP BY resource_type;

SELECT * FROM om_alarm_log oal WHERE content LIKE '%랜더링 시간 측정이 완료%'
ORDER BY rgtr_dt DESC LIMIT 1;

SELECT ocot.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ocot.resource_type, ocot.resource_name) AS row_no, (SELECT SUM(ocrlt.cnt) FROM public.om_resource_call_cnt_month ocrlt WHERE ocrlt.resource_no = ocot.resource_no and yyyy = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) AND mm = EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CURRENT_DATE) ) AS current_month_call_count, (SELECT SUM(ocrlt.cnt) FROM public.om_resource_call_cnt_month ocrlt WHERE ocrlt.resource_no = ocot.resource_no and yyyy = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '1 month') AND mm = EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '1 month') ) AS previous_month_call_count, (SELECT SUM(ocrlt.opt_cnt) FROM public.om_resource_call_cnt_month ocrlt WHERE ocrlt.resource_no = ocot.resource_no and yyyy = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) AND mm = EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CURRENT_DATE) ) AS current_month_opt_count, (SELECT SUM(ocrlt.opt_cnt) FROM public.om_resource_call_cnt_month ocrlt WHERE ocrlt.resource_no = ocot.resource_no and yyyy = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '1 month') AND mm = EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '1 month') ) AS previous_month_opt_count, (SELECT SUM(ocrlt.total_optimized_traffic) FROM public.om_resource_call_cnt_month ocrlt WHERE ocrlt.resource_no = ocot.resource_no and yyyy = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '1 month') AND mm = EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '1 month') ) AS pre_total_optimized_traffic, (SELECT SUM(ocrlt.total_optimized_traffic) FROM public.om_resource_call_cnt_month ocrlt WHERE ocrlt.resource_no = ocot.resource_no and yyyy = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) AND mm = EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CURRENT_DATE) ) AS current_total_optimized_traffic FROM om_cloud_optimizer_tbl ocot WHERE 1 = 1 AND resource_type > 0

SELECT ocot.cloud_no, ocot.resource_new_size_type1, ocot.resource_no, ocrlt.cnt AS current_day_count, ocrlt.opt_cnt AS current_opt_count, (SELECT SUM(ocrlt_inner.total_optimized_traffic) FROM public.om_resource_call_cnt_month ocrlt_inner WHERE ocrlt_inner.resource_no = ocot.resource_no ) AS total_optimized_traffic FROM om_cloud_optimizer_tbl ocot LEFT JOIN public.om_resource_call_cnt_month ocrlt ON ocot.resource_no = ocrlt.resource_no AND ocrlt.yyyy = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM NOW()) AND ocrlt.mm = EXTRACT(MONTH FROM NOW()) AND ocrlt.dd = EXTRACT(DAY FROM NOW()) WHERE 1 = 1 AND resource_type > 0

SELECT ocot.*, (SELECT SUM(ocrlt.opt_cnt) FROM public.om_resource_call_cnt_month ocrlt WHERE ocrlt.resource_no = ocot.resource_no AND ocrlt.yyyy = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) AND ocrlt.mm = EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CURRENT_DATE) ) AS current_month_opt_count, (SELECT SUM(ocrlt.cnt) FROM public.om_resource_call_cnt_month ocrlt WHERE ocrlt.resource_no = ocot.resource_no AND ocrlt.yyyy = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) AND ocrlt.mm = EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CURRENT_DATE) ) AS current_month_call_count FROM om_cloud_optimizer_tbl ocot WHERE resource_status = #{resource_status}
AND resource_org_size > 0 ORDER BY resource_type1_size DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT resource_type, SUM(resource_new_size_type1) AS size1, SUM(resource_new_size_type2) AS size2, ROUND( (SUM(resource_new_size_type1) - SUM(resource_new_size_type2)) / NULLIF(SUM(resource_new_size_type1), 0)::NUMERIC * 100, 1 ) AS percentage FROM om_cloud_optimizer_tbl ocot WHERE 1 = 1 AND resource_new_size_type1 > 0 AND resource_new_size_type2 > 0
GROUP BY resource_type ORDER BY resource_type;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) FROM om_cloud_resource_log_tbl ocrlt WHERE 1 = 1 AND ocrlt.rgstr_dt BETWEEN NOW() - INTERVAL '1 second' AND NOW()

SELECT COUNT(*), SUM(ocot.resource_new_size_type1) AS size1, CASE WHEN SUM(ocot.resource_new_size_type2) = 0 THEN SUM(ocot.resource_new_size_type1) ELSE SUM(ocot.resource_new_size_type2) END AS size2, CASE WHEN SUM(ocot.resource_new_size_type2) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND((SUM(ocot.resource_new_size_type1) - SUM(ocot.resource_new_size_type2)) / SUM(ocot.resource_new_size_type1)::NUMERIC * 100, 2) END AS percentage, ocot.resource_type, ocot.resource_status FROM om_cloud_optimizer_rel_tbl ocort LEFT JOIN om_cloud_optimizer_tbl ocot ON ocort.resource_no = ocot.resource_no WHERE page_no = #{page_no} AND ocot.resource_type BETWEEN 1 AND 4 AND ocot.resource_org_size > 0 GROUP BY ocot.resource_type, ocot.resource_status ORDER BY ocot.resource_type

SELECT COUNT(*), ocort.page_no FROM om_cloud_optimizer_rel_tbl ocort LEFT JOIN om_cloud_optimizer_tbl ocot ON ocort.resource_no = ocot.resource_no WHERE ocot.resource_type BETWEEN 1 AND 4 and ocot.resource_org_size > 0 GROUP BY ocort.page_no ORDER BY ocort.page_no

SELECT * FROM om_cloud_optimizer_rel_tbl ocort LEFT JOIN om_cloud_optimizer_tbl ocot ON ocort.resource_no = ocot.resource_no WHERE ocort.page_no = #{page_no} AND (resource_status = 0 OR resource_status = 11) AND resource_type > 0 AND resource_org_size > 0

SELECT ocot.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ocot.resource_type, ocot.resource_name) AS row_no, (SELECT SUM(ocrlt.cnt) FROM public.om_resource_call_cnt_month ocrlt WHERE ocrlt.resource_no = ocot.resource_no AND yyyy = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) AND mm = EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CURRENT_DATE) AND dd <= EXTRACT(DAY FROM CURRENT_DATE) ) AS current_month_call_count, (SELECT SUM(ocrlt.cnt) FROM public.om_resource_call_cnt_month ocrlt WHERE ocrlt.resource_no = ocot.resource_no AND yyyy = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '1 month') AND mm = EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '1 month') AND dd <= EXTRACT(DAY FROM CURRENT_DATE) ) AS previous_month_call_count, (SELECT SUM(ocrlt.opt_cnt) FROM public.om_resource_call_cnt_month ocrlt WHERE ocrlt.resource_no = ocot.resource_no AND yyyy = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) AND mm = EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CURRENT_DATE) AND dd <= EXTRACT(DAY FROM CURRENT_DATE) ) AS current_month_opt_count, (SELECT SUM(ocrlt.opt_cnt) FROM public.om_resource_call_cnt_month ocrlt WHERE ocrlt.resource_no = ocot.resource_no AND yyyy = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '1 month') AND mm = EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '1 month') AND dd <= EXTRACT(DAY FROM CURRENT_DATE) ) AS previous_month_opt_count, (SELECT SUM(ocrlt.total_optimized_traffic) FROM public.om_resource_call_cnt_month ocrlt WHERE ocrlt.resource_no = ocot.resource_no AND yyyy = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '1 month') AND mm = EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '1 month') AND dd <= EXTRACT(DAY FROM CURRENT_DATE) ) AS pre_total_optimized_traffic, (SELECT SUM(ocrlt.total_optimized_traffic) FROM public.om_resource_call_cnt_month ocrlt WHERE ocrlt.resource_no = ocot.resource_no AND yyyy = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) AND mm = EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CURRENT_DATE) AND dd <= EXTRACT(DAY FROM CURRENT_DATE) ) AS current_total_optimized_traffic FROM om_cloud_optimizer_tbl ocot WHERE 1 = 1 AND ocot.resource_type > 0
